description: This file contains classes and functions for transforming requests and responses between LiteLLM's OpenAI-compatible format and Vertex AI Reasoning Engine's API format, including error handling, configuration, and streaming support.

classes.name: VertexAgentEngineError
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling errors specific to Vertex Agent Engine interactions.

classes.name: VertexAgentEngineConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Vertex AI Agent Engine, handling URL construction, request transformation, response parsing, and streaming support.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI parameters supported by Vertex AI Agent Engine.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to Vertex AI Agent Engine parameters.

methods.name: _parse_model_string
methods.description: Parses the model string to extract resource path and engine ID.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for requests based on model string and parameters.

methods.name: _get_auth_headers
methods.description: Retrieves authentication headers using Google Cloud credentials.

methods.name: _get_user_id
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a user ID for session management.

methods.name: _get_session_id
methods.description: Retrieves session ID from parameters if available.

methods.name: transform_request
methods.description: Transforms input messages into the format required by Vertex AI Agent Engine.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Prepares and validates headers for API environment.

methods.name: _extract_text_from_response
methods.description: Extracts text content from the API response data.

methods.name: _calculate_usage
methods.description: Calculates token usage based on messages and content.

methods.name: transform_response
methods.description: Transforms the raw API response into LiteLLM's ModelResponse format.

methods.name: get_streaming_response
methods.description: Returns an iterator for streaming SSE responses.

methods.name: get_sync_custom_stream_wrapper
methods.description: Creates a synchronous custom stream wrapper for streaming responses.

methods.name: get_async_custom_stream_wrapper
methods.description: Creates an asynchronous custom stream wrapper for streaming responses.

methods.name: supports_stream_param_in_request_body
methods.description: Indicates whether passing 'stream' in request body is supported.

methods.name: get_error_class
methods.description: Returns the appropriate error class for exceptions.

methods.name: should_fake_stream
methods.description: Determines if streaming should be faked; always false as Vertex AI returns real SSE streams.
